grid = [list(map(int,line.split())) for line in test_txt.strip().splitlines()]
# Identify each maximal run along down-right diagonals, keyed by d=c-r.
from collections import defaultdict
pts_by_d=defaultdict(set)
for r,row in enumerate(grid):
    for c,x in enumerate(row):
        if x==6: pts_by_d[c-r].add((r,c))
segments=[]
for d,pts in pts_by_d.items():
    rs=sorted(r for r,c in pts)
    # In these demo/test tracks, each d is contiguous in r.
    groups=[]
    for r in rs:
        if not groups or r>groups[-1][-1]+1: groups.append([r])
        else: groups[-1].append(r)
    for group in groups:
        vvals=[r+(r+d) for r in group]
        segments.append((d,min(vvals),max(vvals),group))
print(sorted(segments))
# Fill all points strictly between adjacent d tracks and inside overlap of endpoint-cap coordinate v=r+c.
segs=sorted(segments,key=lambda x:x[0])
out=[row[:] for row in grid]
for left,right in zip(segs,segs[1:]):
    d1,v1lo,v1hi,_=left; d2,v2lo,v2hi,_=right
    vlo,vhi=max(v1lo,v2lo),min(v1hi,v2hi)
    for r in range(16):
        for c in range(16):
            d=c-r; v=c+r
            if d1<d<d2 and vlo<=v<=vhi and out[r][c]==8:
                out[r][c]=2
print('output:')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
print('2 cells:',[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(out) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==2])
